visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a long shot of Hakata Station's grand exterior under a grey, rainy sky. People holding umbrellas walk across the wet pavement in the foreground. Large text overlays dominate the upper and lower portions of the frame. (2) Transition to Canal City Hakata, showing its unique curved architectural style with red and orange walls and lush green plants hanging from multiple balcony levels. A small artificial canal flows at the bottom. (3) The camera moves inside to a brightly lit Gashapon Official Shop. Rows of white capsule toy machines are stacked high along the aisles. A woman in a black top and light pants walks through the store. (4) Close-up shots of various toys and merchandise, including crane game machines (UFO catchers) and shelves filled with colorful character goods like Pokemon bath bombs and Sanrio items. (5) A montage of different store entrances follows: Sanrio Gallery, Disney Store, Donguri Republic (Totoro), and Jump Shop, showcasing a variety of character-themed retail environments. (6) The scene shifts to the Alpen Fukuoka flagship store, a large multi-story sports retailer. The interior is modern with bright blue LED signs. The main character is seen holding a white shopping bag and smiling near the entrance. (7) Entry into the Tenjin Underground Mall, featuring ornate European-style wrought iron decorations and a warm, dim lighting atmosphere. Shoppers walk through the wide, brick-paved subterranean corridors. (8) Return to the exterior of Hakata Station, showing the entrance to Amu Plaza and Kitte. Close-up shots of delicate raspberry-topped pastries are presented in a bakery display. (9) The final phase shows the main character using a smartphone at a transit gate, followed by promotional graphic overlays detailing Visa card benefits with logos for TableCheck and Expedia.
